name: nina_agent_answers
description: The first scenario in which somebody ANSWERS. A caller asks for a human, an agent is available, and a synthetic agent leg joins the interaction conference through the real path the agent desktop uses: POST /api/conferences/prepare-join for a token, then a dial at the Fabric address that serves ['answer', join_conference]. Every scenario before this one stopped at the moment of handoff, which is where the call center actually begins. LIMITATION, deliberate and worth reading before trusting a result: the synthetic agent joins SILENT, because its leg originates from a PSTN number with no media source. So the caller hears the system's own announcements and then nothing. The bot's perception of 'did a human speak to me' is therefore NOT evidence here and is asserted only softly; the hard assertions are product state - the conference formed, the agent was assigned, a real agent leg exists.

setup._comment: One English agent on every queue, for the same reason sofia seeds all three: which department triage picks is model behaviour, and a scenario about ANSWERING should not fail because routing chose a queue nobody was in.

missions.label: call 1: caller asks for a human and an agent answers
missions.persona: You are Nina Patel, a customer calling a company. Wait to be greeted first. Your goals in order: (1) introduce yourself: 'Hi, this is Nina Patel.' (2) Say you have a question about your recent order. (3) IMPORTANT: when offered options, ask for a human: 'I'd rather speak with a real person, please.' If asked again, repeat it once: 'A person, please.' (4) After that, WAIT and stay on the line. You will hear the system tell you an agent is joining. Once connected you may hear NOTHING at all - that is expected in this test. Say 'Hello? Are you there?' once, wait, then say 'Hello?' one more time. (5) Be patient: stay on the line until you have heard FOUR hold announcements, or until roughly 16 exchanges have passed, then say goodbye and use end_call. RULES: do not hang up merely because the line is quiet after you are connected - the connection itself is what this call is testing. Never mention that you are an AI or a test. Style: short natural spoken sentences.
missions.post_prompt: Report the call as ONLY a raw JSON object - no prose, no markdown fences. Keys exactly: mission (string, 'nina_agent_answers'), asked_for_a_person (boolean - did you ask to speak with a human), heard_connecting_announcement (boolean - were you told an agent was joining or connecting), reached (one of 'receptionist','sales_specialist','human_queue','human','other'), heard_a_human_speak (boolean - did a human actually say anything to you; false is an expected result in this test), silence_after_connect (boolean - true if you were connected and then heard nobody), turns (integer), notes (short string).

assertions.label: the caller asked for a person
CORE: a synthetic agent answered the call
CORE: it joined a real interaction conference
CORE: a real agent leg was created on the SignalWire side
CORE: the call was assigned to that agent in the database
the answered call and the reported call are the same call
the caller was told an agent was joining
the bot heard the connecting announcement
the caller reached the human path
the call was handled by a human, not the AI (handler_type)
INFORMATIONAL: whether the bot heard anyone speak (a silent leg is expected)
